## S1907 (2026-11-01): Serre large image on E'/F' -- no Lean port, precise first missing

**Result: MISSING (no fake).** tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1907SerreLargeImageActual.lean (EXIT=0;
axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only; no sorry, no new axiom; source
SHA256 686BA969B95E1C62C1C1D1C746E5F97453D8EB71FE1441E191AA7DE676F899DF;
olean 102248 bytes SHA256
E97337F97F44566AAEFB0F5355BF304C620D8308CAD10015E624E1D2210F1DBF) records the
uniform target `∀ l ≥ 5, SerreStyleLargeImageStatement S1720Curve l`, proves
`Uniform ↔ ∃ l0, Cofinite l0 ∧ Small l0` and
`(∃ l0, Cofinite l0) ↔ Set.Finite {l | ¬ target}`, and defines the two
missing inputs: `S1907FirstMissing` (only finitely many exceptional
primes; Serre open image / [GenEll] Thm 3.8) and `S1907FiniteVerification`
(explicit mod-l image computation below the threshold, in particular l = 5).
No Lean port was located: Mathlib v4.32.2 has no Tate module / Galois
representation / Faltings height / open-image theorem; TauCeti has the local
Tate module and Serre's local lemma only; the tree's audit cards
`IUT-I.elliptic-l-torsion-large-image` and
`Foundations.Geometry.elliptic-tate-uniformization` are pending;
the `tmp/external` IUT ports contain only source-hypothesis shapes.
[GenEll] Thm 3.8 does not cover l=5 (condition (b) excludes 2*3*5; condition
(a) is >= 23040 for a fixed curve), so the uniform statement needs the finite
check in addition to open image.
